name: dct
expr: y_v = dct(x); y_M = dct(M); y_n6 = dct(x, 6); y_n10 = dct(x, 10); y_M_dim2 = dct(M, 4, 2);
comment: Sig: Y = dct(X[, n[, dim]]). DCT-II (default Type=2). Bug fix 2026-05-08: matrix input was treated as flat numel-vector — now per-column (default) or per-row via dim=2; length override n pads/truncates; positive 'Type' values other than 2 explicitly error (was silently doing Type-II).
